scripts.title: 1.11.02 OpenID configuration at the issuer
scripts.description: g10 1.11.02 / 1.10.02 / 3.10.02 / 3.9.02 (AUT-PAT-23). scripts.title: 8.2.02 Group export is declared in the CapabilityStatement
scripts.description: g10 8.2.02 / 7.2.02 (SH-PAT-4). The CapabilityStatement declares the Group-level export operation and instantiates the Bulk Data server CapabilityStatement. Inferno fails without a Group operation and warns about the rest; here every check is required.
scripts.knownFailure: Bulk Data: no $export operation, and GET operation invocations answer 501. The kick-off scripts stop with an execution error when no Content-Location comes back.

assertions.label: Group declares at least one operation
The export operation is the Bulk Data group-export
The server instantiates the Bulk Data CapabilityStatement

scripts.title: 8.2.03 An export kick-off without authorization is rejected
scripts.description: g10 8.2.03 / 7.2.03 (AUT-SYS-10, DAT-PAT-11). A Group export kick-off without a valid access token is rejected with 400 or 401. Inferno sends no Authorization header; the runner cannot drop the header, so this sends an invalid bearer token instead.

scripts.title: 8.2.04 and 8.2.05 Group export kick-off and status
scripts.description: g10 8.2.04 / 7.2.04 (SH-PAT-5, DAT-PAT-10) and 8.2.05 / 7.2.05 (DAT-PAT-13). GET Group/[id]/$export with Prefer: respond-async answers 202 with a Content-Location status URL; polling it answers 202 until the export completes, then 200 with an application/json manifest. The manifest's fields (8.2.06) and the NDJSON files (8.3) are not FHIR resources, which a TestScript cannot inspect.
scripts.knownFailure: Bulk Data: no $export operation, and GET operation invocations answer 501. The kick-off scripts stop with an execution error when no Content-Location comes back.

scripts.description: g10 8.4.01 / 7.4.01 and 8.4.02 (DAT-PAT-12). A DELETE of an export's status URL answers 202, and a poll of the cancelled export answers 404 with an OperationOutcome.

scripts.title: g10: the US Core patient record
scripts.description: Run as admin before every g10 scenario. Writes, in one transaction of PUTs with fixed ids, the US Core examples (artifacts/r4/test-data/testscripts) with ids prefixed g10-: four patients, Patient/g10-example holding data for every US Core profile, and the practitioners, organizations, locations and medications they reference. Every resource is tagged g10.
